title: Toronto Application 24 254930 Council-Gate Item History
summary: Toronto's item history records the Scarborough Community Council recommendation, July 29-31 City Council gate, and conditions that can withhold amendment bills for application 24 254930.
key_findings: The record identifies a specific Council item and decision window.
A revised wind study, land exchange, and laneway conditions sit upstream of amendment enactment.
The item remains upstream of by-laws, building permits, construction, completion, and occupancy.
why_it_matters: The record turns a broad housing-conversion question into a named municipal chain whose next legal and physical stages can be checked.
ftfn_relevance: Maintains the Ontario dossier's dated decision gate.
Prevents committee recommendation from being reported as final adoption.
evidence_limits: The pre-meeting record does not establish Council adoption or enacted by-laws.
It does not prove condition compliance, permit issuance, financing, construction start, completion, or occupancy.
